scope.research_question: Can a train-only monotone affine correction of frozen raw-quantity predictions remove the remaining raw-scale bias without changing the Hard-LMM backbone, time path, or causal inputs?
permitted_claims: calibrated end-to-end predictor comparison when every backbone receives the same fitting and activation rule
forbidden_claims: Hard-LMM backbone improvement caused by this calibrator
memory retrieval improvement caused by this calibrator
universal superiority from seed42 validation alone
held-out generalization before the held-out lock is separately opened

prior_evidence.distinction: The prior candidates learned bounded or unbounded corrections in quantity-logit space from older joint-selected checkpoints and did not optimize raw MSE. This candidate fits two parameters directly in raw-quantity space from the later raw-RMSE-selected checkpoints. It revisits the same global-bias hypothesis and is not a new memory mechanism.

scope.evaluation_order: validation is unavailable until B passes the train-only necessary condition on all three datasets

calibration.name: frozen_monotone_affine_raw_quantity
calibration.base_prediction: q_base is the frozen source checkpoint's nonnegative raw-quantity point prediction
calibration.fit_definition: Compute centered float64 ordinary least squares for the unclipped affine map, project a nonpositive slope to the fixed minimum slope, refit the unpenalized intercept at that slope, then apply the nonnegative projection only at prediction time.
calibration.fit_objective: unclipped affine raw-scale SSE; this is not claimed to be the optimum of the subsequently clipped prediction SSE
calibration.fit_population: all canonical train next-event targets and their causally generated source predictions
calibration.event_weighting: one equal weight per canonical next-event target, matching the official raw RMSE aggregation
calibration.fit_failure_policy: record failure and stop; do not change the fit, minimum slope, folds, or activation rule

series_disjoint_two_fold.limitation: The frozen source checkpoint was trained on the whole train split, so these folds do not constitute an independently trained backbone comparison.
series_disjoint_two_fold.assignment_unit: canonical dataset series index derived from the sorted series identifier; every target from one series remains in one fold
series_disjoint_two_fold.assignment: Normalize each canonical series identifier to a typed token, then fold = uint64(first eight bytes of SHA256(UTF8(fold_salt + ':' + token)), big-endian) mod 2
series_disjoint_two_fold.source_activation_rule: activate calibration only when both held-out train-fold raw RMSE values are strictly lower than identity, combined cross-fitted raw RMSE improves by at least 1%, and combined cross-fitted body MAE and >p99 MAE regressions are each at most 2%; otherwise use identity
series_disjoint_two_fold.failure_action_for_B: stop before validation if B is inactive on any dataset
series_disjoint_two_fold.baseline_policy: Instacart RMTPP and THP use the identical activation rule; identity fallback is an outcome of that common train-only rule, not a validation selection

final_fit.condition: run only after the source passes its train-only two-fold activation rule
final_fit.selection: one deterministic full-train OLS fit; no epoch selection and no validation-based identity fallback
saved_state: unclipped affine SSE, clipped SSE, and clamp count
source checkpoint file and state SHA256
data, split, train-target identity and train-target quantity SHA256

unchanged_paths: training data split and target population
checkpoint_and_contract_tests: identity a=1 b=0 reproduces every frozen raw-quantity prediction exactly
identity and fitted calibration leave every time output and per-event Time NLL exactly unchanged within the same 5080 replay
source state SHA256 is unchanged before and after extraction and fitting
the deterministic OLS fit creates no optimizer or source-model gradient path
target and padding permutation cannot change inference predictions when q_hat is held fixed
all fitted parameters, predictions, and losses are finite on observed and declared stress inputs
a is strictly positive and every q_cal is nonnegative without an undeclared upper cap
saved calibration state restores the exact parameters and prediction vector
corrupt, partial, wrong-source, wrong-dataset, or wrong-fold states are rejected
output directories are never overwritten and no automatic retry changes the prospective fit

acceptance.quantity_strata: train-only p50, p90, p95, and p99 boundaries pinned per dataset below
acceptance.quantity_boundary_estimator: numpy.quantile(method='nearest') over canonical train next-event targets
acceptance.cross_dataset_summary: report dataset-wise relative changes and their unweighted macro mean only; do not pool raw errors across datasets

train_only_necessary_condition.failure_action: stop before loading or evaluating validation predictions

required_reporting: series-clustered paired bootstrap interval for MAE and squared-error deltas
B_three_dataset_validation_gate.failure_action: reject the common calibration candidate and do not reinterpret a dataset-wise subset as a common improvement

instacart_fairness_gate.prerequisite: B passes the three-dataset validation gate
comparison_rows: B with its prospectively fitted calibration pipeline
RMTPP with the identical calibration fitting and train-only activation pipeline
THP with the identical calibration fitting and train-only activation pipeline
instacart_fairness_gate.interpretation: A pass supports a calibrated-predictor comparison only. It does not attribute the gain to the Hard-LMM backbone because calibration is an output-interface ablation.
instacart_fairness_gate.failure_action: do not claim calibrated B superiority on Instacart and do not add seeds or open held-out test

acceptance.seed42_limit: Every gate in this contract is exploratory seed42 validation evidence. Additional seeds require a separately frozen extension contract.
acceptance.held_out_test: locked and unavailable for fitting, activation, selection, threshold changes, or evaluation

execution_order: verify source, contract, data, split, target identities, and checkpoint file/state SHA256
run local unit and contract tests
run train-only 5080 CUDA extraction smoke and real-batch identity/finite checks for B on all three datasets
extract full train predictions for B on all three datasets
evaluate the B series-disjoint two-fold train-only necessary condition
if and only if all B train-only gates pass, run B validation CUDA smoke, fit B on full train, and evaluate the separate three-dataset validation gate
if and only if the B validation gate passes, extract and fit Instacart RMTPP and THP with the same pipeline and evaluate the fairness gate
write an independent artifact audit and stop
runtime.source_transfer: committed source and pinned checkpoint artifacts only, each verified by SHA256 in an isolated 5080 path
